title: In-cell discovery and characterization of a non-canonical bacterial protein translocation-folding complex.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: no PMCID, no full text, no supplement, no text-mined accessions, no NCBI links. Searched the EMDB (Electron Microscopy Data Bank) API and found one released entry, EMD-55029 (ribosome-dome complex with the Sec-translocon from Mycoplasma pneumoniae, Mahamid lab), released 2026-10-07. Did not download the density map.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything else comes from the abstract: in-cell cryo-ET (cryo-electron tomography, 3D imaging of frozen cells) maps, proteomics, integrative models, and three uncharacterized dome proteins (Mdps) that resemble the folding helper PrsA.

a1_downloadable.note: EMDB entry EMD-55029 is public. Paywalled paper with no supplement in Europe PMC.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Output is a few 3D density maps and structural models of one complex. There is no table with a label column, so any prediction target would have to be built.

a3_inputs_present.note: No per-example feature table. The inputs are volumetric maps and tomograms.

a4_units_stated.note: Not applicable: no tabular measurements found.

a5_enough_rows.note: A handful of maps of one complex in one species. Far below 400 labelled examples.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Individual maps are usually small, but raw tomograms would be large.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No counts available to compare: no full text.

a8_label_provenance.note: No label exists. Protein identities in the maps partly rest on structure prediction and integrative modelling.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: the data is a structural description of one complex, not a labelled set of examples.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use protein sequences to predict which bacterial proteins join the newly found extracellular folding dome.
plain_idea.train_on: Would need sequences of dome-like folding helper proteins across bacteria. This paper provides about three such proteins from one species, so the count is about 3.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a protein is a dome component or folding helper. The only true answers would be the three Mdps placed into cryo-ET maps by modelling.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: It could flag similar folding systems in other minimal bacteria, but three examples from one species cannot support a model.

ml_idea: None viable. This is an in-cell structural biology paper whose deposited data is EMDB density maps (EMD-55029) of a single complex.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated: project rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count the deposited labelled examples. One EMDB map of one complex was found, so the project dies at this check.

verdict_reason: A cryo-ET structural study of one complex. The data is a few density maps with no label column and nowhere near enough examples (fails A2, A5).
